gates: cargo test (workspace, includes the capability law suites)

periods.description: Every chain member's governing period — [effective_from, until the next pick) — derived and sorted by pick date. The until end is computed, never stored.

resolve.description: Which plan is in force on the date: the latest pick at or before it, ties broken by id (deterministic, order-insensitive). Unversioned plans never resolve; no pick yet answers null.

validate.description: Chain validity: unique plan ids, every versioned plan effective-dated, pick dates unique. Every violation is reported (kind-tagged); unversioned plans are standalone and never flagged.

purpose: The service-plan chain: which plan governs a date. Service changes are PICKS — a few a year at defined dates — and the chain over the plan set's metadata is DERIVED, never stored: a pick's date is a target that moves while the pick is in development. resolve answers which pick is in force; periods windows every member; validate reports chain invariant violations. Unversioned plans are standalone: they never resolve, never flag. Pure ops over the metadata the host pushes per call.
